facts.education: BS Computer Science, NED University Karachi, 2018

ux-1.proof: BS Computer Science, NED University Karachi, 2018

ux-2.note: Three UI/UX roles since Sep 2018, over eight years. That is more than the advert's "3-5 years", which is read as at least 3.

ux-3.proof: Lead the UI/UX design of the mobile wallet: user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity screens in Figma, with prototypes tested before each release.

ux-5.proof: Set up a routine of monthly user interviews and usability tests, and rebuilt onboarding as a responsive, WCAG 2.1 AA flow; sign-up drop-off fell from 41% to 23%.

ux-6.proof: Work daily with front-end developers and two product teams; introduced design tokens so that code and design files stay in step.

why: Strong and senior, with eight years where the advert says "3-5 years". He must not be marked down for having more. A two-column PDF, so lines of the two columns can get mixed when the text is read.
